questions.keynoteSlide: Slide 06 · The Birth of Native Streaming
questions.speakerPrompt: Taimur Rahman: "Who remembers the humble beginnings in 2019 when we first took Bangladesh by storm?"
questions.q: In what year did Toffee officially launch in Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: Toffee launched commercially in November 2019, quickly becoming Bangladesh's highest-rated entertainment app.

questions.speakerPrompt: Taimur Rahman: "We set out to reach every household. Look at the numbers today on this 40ft LED!"
questions.q: How many lifetime users have experienced Toffee streaming to date?
questions.explanation: Over 95M–100M unique viewers have streamed content on Toffee across mobile and connected TV.

questions.speakerPrompt: Taimur Rahman: "From the historic FIFA World Cup 2022 to the Asia Cup and EPL live at 60 FPS!"
questions.q: How many global sporting tournaments & World Cups were broadcast on Toffee?
questions.explanation: Toffee has streamed 8 mega tournaments including FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022, Asia Cup, and ICC World Cups.

questions.speakerPrompt: Taimur Rahman: "You all experienced it outside in the foyer just an hour ago — our revolutionary AI activation!"
questions.q: What new AI feature introduces local dialect voice-morphing for creators?
questions.explanation: The Dub Booth allows creators to voice-dub iconic cinema scenes into regional Bangla dialects (Noakhali, Chittagong, Sylheti) and global languages.

questions.keynoteSlide: Slide 30 · The Next 7 Years of Streaming
questions.speakerPrompt: Taimur Rahman: "Our theme for tonight represents not just today, but our contract with the future!"
questions.q: What is the official 7-year anniversary summit theme of ToffeeCon 2026?
questions.explanation: "Screen of Tomorrow" is the defining keynote theme for Toffee's next 7 years of interactive entertainment.
